messages:
maya: Heads-up — we need a minimal hotfix for the tokenization edge-case hitting some prod customers. Planning v2.3.10, tiny diff, cutoff in 60m. Can anyone take the branch work and coord the cherry-picks?

alex: I can take the branch. Confirming target branch is release/2.3.x and we'll open hotfix/2.3.10?

maya: yes — release/2.3.x is correct. hotfix/2.3.10 is the branch name. Keep changes to just the tokenizer patch + version bump + changelog entry.

jing: quick QA checklist — unit tests + integration smoke, then a short canary to 10% traffic. Anything else?

sam: also add a semantic-preserve test for the new edge case, low risk but worth the one-liner. I'll review the PR once it's up.

release-coordinator: Procedure I'll follow:
1) create branch from release/2.3.x: `git checkout -b hotfix/2.3.10 origin/release/2.3.x`
2) cherry-pick commits: `git cherry-pick -x <sha-of-tokenizer-fix>`
3) bump version and CHANGES.md, push branch and open PR against release/2.3.x
4) run CI (unit + integration smoke).
5) if green, merge -> create tag `v2.3.10` and trigger canary deploy to 10% -> monitor 30m -> full rollout.

release-coordinator: Example commands: 
```
git checkout -b hotfix/2.3.10 origin/release/2.3.x
git cherry-pick -x abcdef12
# update package.json / VERSION
git commit -am "bump: v2.3.10 — tokenizer edge-case fix"
git push origin hotfix/2.3.10
# open PR -> target release/2.3.x
```

alex: I'll push the branch in ~10m and ping for reviews. Can someone oncall give the greenlight for a 10% canary after merge? @eng-oncall

eng-oncall: oncall here — happy to watch the canary. Please include the simple health checks and logs I asked for in the PR description.

maya: changelog note: one line — "Fix tokenizer crash on \"\" empty-string inputs; no behavior changes otherwise." Put it under Unreleased -> 2.3.10.

jing: CI note: integration-flaky test `token-roundtrip` has been noisy; exclude it from the canary gate if necessary but keep it failing -> we can still proceed if all core tests pass and smoke is good. (Add a note in the PR).

sam: review checklist for the PR: small diff, include CHANGES.md, add test, CI green, @sam review, @maya signoff. If all good, merge and tag.

alex: branch pushed and PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/4832 — PTAL @sam @maya @jing

deploy-bot: CI passed: unit (✅), integration (✅), lint (✅), smoke (✅). Waiting on approvals.

sam: review done, small nits left, requesting tiny change to commit message.

alex: fixed commit message and force-pushed.

maya: approving now. Merging in 2m unless anyone objects.

release-coordinator: Merged and tagged as `v2.3.10`. Starting canary to 10% now. Watch the rollout dashboard: https://internal.redwood/dash/rollouts/2.3.10

eng-oncall: Canary live. Initial health checks green. CPU and latency look stable.

deploy-bot: Canary metrics: errors down to 0.2% from 1.1% on samples of affected requests.

maya: nice work team. Keep monitoring for 45m, then we'll push to 50% and then full after another 30m if all good.

jing: leaving a note to rollback plan in the PR: to rollback we can `git tag -f v2.3.10 v2.3.9` and re-deploy tags or use the rollback endpoint in console to pin traffic back to `v2.3.9` image.

sam: +1 on rollback plan. Also add a postmortem checklist if anything repeats.

release-coordinator: 45m elapsed, canary still stable. Proceeding to 50% then full in 30m.

deploy-bot: Rollout at 50% completed. Monitoring continues.

maya: thanks everyone. I'll file a short internal changelog and send a customer note to the affected accounts. :thumbsup:

eng-oncall: thanks — standing by if anything spikes.

release-coordinator: Final rollout 100% complete. Closing this thread.

maya: closing — great quick coordination, minimal diff as planned. :tada:
